title: It is a pretty bowl!
text:
It is a pretty bowl!. My cereal, rice, soup, salad, pasta bowl came in styrofoam so giving it as a gift would not work. Nothing else was with it, bowl and styrofoam. I needed to come back here to Amazon to read exactly how I could use it. " not dishwasher or microwave safe" and all the above as they chose to call it.

It is a pretty bowl and thick ceramic. I bought the black one.
